messages:
maya: Quick thread from today's All-Hands security segment. Dropping a couple of follow-ups that PMs asked during Q&A about audits, key access, and eDiscovery costs. Keeping it short here so we can turn into a 1-pager.

maya: Questions: 1) If a prospect asks for auditor access, what level can we give pre-contract? 2) For BYOK in Private, do we ever unwrap customer keys in Redwood infra? 3) What's the standard turnaround + cost for ad-hoc log exports for legal/eDiscovery?

maria: Good set. Answers short first, details after: auditor access = redacted read-only via auditor portal (NDA recommended). BYOK = we do not unwrap plaintext unless an escrow activation is approved. Ad-hoc exports = support-assisted, cost depends on size/time; we provide estimate per request.

maria: More detail: Auditor access flow -> send auditor invite to portal; audit token is time-limited (default 72h). Pre-contract we can grant a redacted snapshot + architecture diagrams; full evidence requires NDA and legal sign-off.

ravi: Technical note on BYOK: Private deployments can be configured with customer KMS/HSMs. We implement envelope encryption; Redwood never stores unwrapped customer key material. Escrow path uses threshold HSM shares and requires two-person approval and an approved change ticket.

oliver: For sales: what's the one-liner we can use about keys and audits?

sasha: One-liner: "We manage keys for hosted customers; Dedicated and Private customers can bring keys (BYOK). Escrow is available under contract and requires audit/legal controls." Keep it short.

maria: eDiscovery/log export: hosted customers -> support-assisted export, typical SLA 5-10 business days for small exports, 2-4 weeks for large volume (cost estimate before work). Dedicated/Private -> self-serve export to customer S3 or webhook for notifications.

maya: Any sample webhook or payload we can give PMs?

ravi: Example event (single-line): {"event":"audit.export.ready","job_id":"J-12345","url":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/acme/exp/J-12345.ndjson.gz","expires":"2026-06-01T12:00:00Z"}

maria: Deletion/retention: BYOK deletion requests must be initiated by customer admin and include a signed request. We enforce a 30-day quiesce period to avoid accidental data loss and log the entire lifecycle. For Redwood-managed keys we follow the internal key lifecycle and provide advance notice to customers when key material is retired.

sasha: Legal note: any external sharing of logs that may contain personal data requires DPA amendment + redaction plan. Also auditors must use the auditor portal; direct S3 access to raw evidence is gated.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-9433 "Audit portal invite flow + one-pager for PMs" assigned to maria, sasha. ETA: 7 business days.

maya: Thanks team. Can we get the one-pager + a short public FAQ blurb for Sales? If so, drop links here when ready and I'll add to the product PRD template.

maria: Will draft the one-pager and the sales blurb (2 versions: public & internal) and upload to /security/comms/ within 5 business days. Will tag @maya and @ravi for review. :thumbsup:

oliver: +1, will wait for links.

maya: Closing thread, will reopen if more PMs add questions.
